description.narrative: Naturvårdsverket undersöker möjligheter och utformning av bilateralt samarbete inom miljöområdet i Makedonien. Huvudsaklig samarbetspart är miljöministeriet i Skopje, men även andra relevanta partners kommer att involveras. En inledande fas, där problemformulering, förslag till samarbetsområden och arbetssätt diskuteras med samarbetspartners i Makedonien, äger rum under 2018. Resultatet av denna fas ligger sedan till grund för beslut om eventuellt fortsatt bilateralt samarbete.

The Swedish Environmental Protection Agency (SEPA) is undertaking a scoping mission to Macedonia to investigate opportunities for a bilateral cooperation within the area of environment. The main counterpart is the Ministry of Environment in Skopje, but also other relevant partners will be involved. The scoping mission to be undertaken during 2018 will identify and review possible areas for cooperation as well as cooperation modalities. The result of this first phase will be the basis for the decision on a possible continued bilateral cooperation.

SEPA has finalised the scoping mission and the reporting on that. SEPA, together with the Minstry of the Environment in Skopje, submitted a proposal to Sida for a cooperation programme involving three sub-areas (nature protection, air quality and EU negotiation preparations). The bilateral cooperation program was appraised and an agreement on support finalised spring 2019 (11574).
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
